shown.description:
The workspaces that always have a dot, whether they exist or not (a number 1 .. 20 each, 1 to 10 of them). A workspace that
exists beside these gets a dot while it exists. The groove has room for two dots on each side of the clock; more stand closer.

Takes a list of whole numbers. Default: [1,2,3,4].

scope.description:
"all": every bar shows every workspace. "screen": a bar shows only the workspaces that are on its own display (and, of "shown", the
ones that are nowhere yet or that Panorama keeps on that display). "all" | "screen".

Takes "all" or "screen". Default: "all".
